write_tools.post: WRITES: publishes a post on the user's account, visible to everyone (refused unless BLUESKY_WRITE=1)
write_tools.thread: WRITES: publishes up to 10 posts as a thread on the user's account (refused unless BLUESKY_WRITE=1)
write_tools.delete_post: WRITES: deletes one of the account's own posts (refused unless BLUESKY_WRITE=1)

mcp.reason: publishes to or deletes from your Bluesky account
